hero_tagline: Evidence and messages from loved ones in spirit, delivered with honesty and care.
hero_intro: 1-2-1 readings and evenings of mediumship across the North of England and the Midlands, and video readings wherever you are.
readings_text: A private, face-to-face sitting. I'll share what spirit gives me: names, memories, personality and the small details only you would recognise, so you can be sure who's stepping forward.
video_text: Spirit isn't limited by distance, and neither are you. Video readings work just like sitting across the table from me, wherever you are in the world.
group_text: An evening of live demonstration in front of an audience. I move around the room passing on messages, and there's always laughter alongside the tears.
house_party_text: Gather your friends and family at home. Each guest has their own private reading in a quiet room, so it's relaxed, personal and a night to remember.
about_portrait_alt: Connor Boyd sitting at a reading table, smiling
about_lead: I'm Connor, a gifted and evidential spiritual medium.
about_paragraphs: Evidence is at the heart of my work. When a loved one comes through, I pass on the memories, personality and small details that only you would recognise, so you can be certain who is with you.
My style is direct, honest and grounded. Alongside messages from loved ones in spirit, a reading can bring clarity and direction to what's happening in your life here and now.
Whether we're sitting one to one, connecting by video or I'm demonstrating to a full room, my aim is always the same: to bring comfort, reassurance and a clearer way forward.

faq_intro: If yours isn't here, just ask. I'm always happy to talk it through.

faq.question: What happens in a reading?
faq.answer: We'll sit together, in person or on video, and I'll tune in to spirit. I'll describe who's coming through and pass on the details and messages they give me. You only need to answer yes or no; there's no need to tell me anything about yourself.

faq.question: Can you bring through a specific person?
faq.answer: I can't promise who will come through. Spirit decides who steps forward, and it's often the person you least expect. Go in with an open heart and you're far more likely to recognise what's given.

faq.question: Do video readings work as well as in-person ones?
faq.answer: Yes. The connection is with spirit, not the room. Many people find video readings even more relaxed because they're in their own home.

faq.question: How does a spiritual house party work?
faq.answer: You invite friends or family and provide a quiet room. Each guest has a private reading with me in turn while everyone else enjoys the evening. Get in touch with your date, location and rough number of guests and I'll send the details.

faq.question: Is there a minimum age?
faq.answer: Readings and events are for adults aged 18 and over.

faq.question: What if I need to change or cancel?
faq.answer: Any booking can be transferred to another slot with at least 24 hours' notice. If you cancel with less notice than that, I may not be able to transfer your booking, so please let me know as soon as you can.
